title: Reverse Array
question: Reverse array in-place.

solution.code:
def reverseArray(arr):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return arr

explanation: Solve reverse array using an efficient approach.
